title: The Little Savage
author: Frederick Marryat
description: "The Little Savage" by Captain Marryat is a novel written during the early 19th century.
longDescription: The book tells the story of Frank Henniker, a boy who finds himself on a deserted island, growing up in the company of a brutal man named Jackson, who has a dark past.

authorInfo.bio: Frederick Marryat (1792–1848) wrote The Children of the New Forest. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
